scalars.name: AddressString
scalars.description:
An address as a checksummed hex string (0x-prefixed, 42 characters).
Example: "0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045"

scalars.name: BigInt
scalars.description:
Arbitrary precision integer, represented as a string.
Used for values that may exceed JavaScript's safe integer range (2^53).
Examples: "0", "115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935"

scalars.name: BlockHash
scalars.description:
Block hash as a 66-character hex string (0x-prefixed).
Example: "0x88e96d4537bea4d9c05d12549907b32561d3bf31f45aae734cdc119f13406cb6"

scalars.name: BlockNumber
scalars.description:
Block number as a positive integer representing the block height.
Example: 17000000

scalars.name: Cursor
scalars.description: Opaque cursor for pagination. Pass to the 'after' parameter to fetch the next page of results.

scalars.name: Gas
scalars.description:
Gas amount as a positive integer representing gas units.
Example: 21000 for a simple ETH transfer.

scalars.name: Int256
scalars.description: Signed 256-bit integer.

scalars.name: Int64
scalars.description: Signed 64-bit integer.

scalars.name: JSON
scalars.description: Arbitrary JSON data. Used for raw metadata and unstructured content.

scalars.name: Map
scalars.description: Key-value map type.

scalars.name: Timestamp
scalars.description:
ISO 8601 formatted timestamp in UTC.
Example: "2024-01-15T14:30:00Z"

scalars.name: TokenId
scalars.description:
NFT token identifier. Passed as a string because token IDs are uint256 values
that can exceed JavaScript's safe integer range (2^53).
Examples: "0", "1234", "57896044618658097711785492504343953926634992332820282019728792003956564819968"

scalars.name: TransactionHash
scalars.description:
Transaction hash as a 66-character hex string (0x-prefixed).
Example: "0x5c504ed432cb51138bcf09aa5e8a410dd4a1e204ef84bfed1be16dfba1b22060"

scalars.name: UInt160
scalars.description: Unsigned 160-bit integer, typically used for addresses in raw form.

scalars.name: UInt256
scalars.description: Unsigned 256-bit integer, represented as a string.

scalars.name: UInt32
scalars.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer.

scalars.name: UInt64
scalars.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer.

scalars.name: UInt8
scalars.description: Unsigned 8-bit integer.

scalars.name: UUID
scalars.description: Universally unique identifier (UUID v4).

scalars.name: Wei
scalars.description:
Wei amount as a string. Wei is the smallest unit of the native currency (1 native token = 10^18 Wei).
Example: "1000000000000000000" represents 1 native token.

Base interface for any address on chain, whether an externally owned account (EOA) or a smart contract.
Provides common fields for address identification, activity tracking, and asset balances.

interface Address {
  "The address as a checksummed hex string (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
  address: AddressString!
  "Number of transactions sent from this address. For EOAs, this is the account nonce. For contracts, this represents internal transaction count."
  nonce: Int!
  "Timestamp of the most recent transaction involving this address, or null if never active."
  lastActiveAt: Timestamp
  "Total number of transactions where this address was the sender or recipient."
  transactionCount: Int!
  "ERC-20 token balances held by this address, paginated."
  tokenBalances(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for token balances."
    where: TokenBalanceFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: TokenBalanceOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): TokenBalanceList!
  "NFT balances held by this address, paginated."
  nftBalances(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for NFT balances."
    where: NFTBalanceFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: NFTBalanceOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): NFTBalanceList!
  "Transactions involving this address as sender or recipient, paginated."
  transactions(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for transactions."
    where: TransactionFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: TransactionOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): TransactionList!
}


Base interface for smart contracts deployed on chain.
Extends the Address interface with contract-specific metadata including deployment information and token standards.

interface IContract implements Address {
  "The contract address as a checksummed hex string (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
  address: AddressString!
  "Number of internal transactions or contract interactions initiated by this contract."
  nonce: Int!
  "Timestamp of the most recent transaction involving this contract, or null if never active after deployment."
  lastActiveAt: Timestamp
  "Total number of transactions where this contract was involved."
  transactionCount: Int!
  "ERC-20 token balances held by this contract, paginated."
  tokenBalances(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for token balances."
    where: TokenBalanceFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: TokenBalanceOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): TokenBalanceList!
  "NFT balances held by this contract, paginated."
  nftBalances(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for NFT balances."
    where: NFTBalanceFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: NFTBalanceOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): NFTBalanceList!
  "Transactions involving this contract, paginated."
  transactions(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for transactions."
    where: TransactionFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: TransactionOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): TransactionList!
  "Token standards implemented by this contract, detected via ERC-165 or function signature analysis."
  standards: [Standard!]!
  "Human-readable name of the contract or token collection (e.g., 'USD Coin', 'Bored Ape Yacht Club'), or null if not available."
  name: String
  "Token symbol (e.g., 'USDC', 'BAYC'), or null if not available."
  symbol: String
  "Timestamp when the contract was deployed to the blockchain."
  createdAt: Timestamp
  "The block in which the contract was deployed."
  createdInBlock: Block
  "The transaction that deployed this contract."
  createdByTransaction: Transaction
  "The address (EOA or contract) that deployed this contract."
  creator: Address
}


Implemented by NFTs that have exactly one owner at a time (ERC-721 style).
The holder field provides direct access to the current owner.

interface SingleHolder {
  "The current owner of this NFT."
  holder: Address!
}


Implemented by NFTs that can have multiple owners simultaneously (ERC-1155 style).
Each holder can own a different quantity of the same token ID.

interface MultipleHolders {
  "Number of unique addresses currently holding this NFT."
  holdersCount: Int!
  "Paginated list of addresses holding this NFT and their balances."
  holders(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for NFT holders."
    where: NFTHolderFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: NFTHolderOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): NFTHolderList!
}


Implemented by token contracts that use decimal precision for amounts.
Primarily ERC-20 tokens and similar fungible token standards where amounts need decimal representation.

interface HasDecimals {
  "Number of decimal places used to represent token amounts. Common values: 18 (most tokens), 6 (USDC, USDT), 8 (WBTC)."
  decimals: Int!
}


Base interface for paginated list responses.
All list types in the schema implement this interface to provide consistent pagination.

interface PaginatedList {
  "Total number of items matching the query across all pages."
  totalCount: Int!
  "Pagination metadata for navigating through results."
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
}


Base interface for non-fungible tokens (NFTs).
Implemented by SingleHolderNFT (ERC-721) and MultiHolderNFT (ERC-1155).
Contains fields common to all NFT types regardless of ownership model.

interface NFT {
  "The contract that manages this NFT collection."
  contract: NFTContract!
  "Unique identifier for this NFT within its contract. Token IDs are uint256 values represented as strings."
  tokenId: TokenId!
  "The token standard this NFT conforms to (ERC721 or ERC1155)."
  standard: Standard!
  "Human-readable name of this NFT from its metadata, or null if not available."
  name: String
  "Parsed metadata for this NFT including name, description, image URL, and attributes."
  metadata: Metadata
  "Media files associated with this NFT (images, videos, audio, etc.)."
  media: [Media!]!
}

objectTypes.name: Transaction
objectTypes.description:
Look up any address (EOA or contract) by its address string.
  Returns null if the address has never been seen on-chain.
  
  address(
    "The address to look up (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
    address: AddressString!
  ): Address

  "Search and filter addresses with pagination."
  addresses(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for addresses."
    where: AddressFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: AddressOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): AddressList!

  
  Look up a smart contract by its address.
  Returns the appropriate contract type (Token, NFTContract, or Contract) based on detected standards.
  Returns null if the address is not a contract.
  
  contract(
    "The contract address to look up (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
    address: AddressString!
  ): IContract

  "Search and filter smart contracts with pagination."
  contracts(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for contracts."
    where: ContractFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: ContractOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): ContractList!

  
  Look up a fungible token (ERC-20) by its contract address.
  Returns null if the address is not an ERC-20 token contract.
  
  token(
    "The token contract address to look up (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
    address: AddressString!
  ): Token

  "Search and filter ERC-20 tokens with pagination."
  tokens(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for tokens."
    where: TokenFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: TokenOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): TokenList!

  
  Look up a specific NFT by its contract address and token ID.
  Returns null if the NFT doesn't exist or hasn't been minted.
  
  nft(
    "The NFT contract address (0x-prefixed, 42 characters)."
    contract: AddressString!
    "The token ID within the contract (as a string to support uint256 values)."
    tokenId: TokenId!
  ): NFT

  "Search and filter NFTs across all contracts with pagination. Supports cross-contract search by name."
  nfts(
    "Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)."
    first: Int = 10
    "Cursor for pagination. Pass the endCursor from a previous query to get the next page."
    after: Cursor
    "Filter criteria for NFTs, including contract filters for cross-contract search."
    where: NFTFilter
    "Field to sort results by."
    orderBy: NFTOrderBy
    "Sort direction (ascending or descending)."
    orderDirection: OrderDirection
  ): NFTList!

  
  Look up a transaction by its hash.
  Returns null if the transaction doesn't exist or is still pending.
  
  transaction(
